'''Red dragons''' are an enemy encountered in the [[Dragonkin Laboratory]]. Like most [[dragons]], they are susceptible to the [[Dragon Slayer (perk)|Dragon Slayer perk]] and [[dragonbane]] ammunition. A method of protection from [[dragonfire]] is highly recommended against them.

In Story mode its health is reduced by 50% and its damage output is reduced by 90%.
